consumerAudit.ScanEngine: After readCandidate projects the source, downstream matching/final issues use source.snapshot/source.outcome/source.readReason and projections. They do not traverse raw objects/properties/relationships.
consumerAudit.OpScanReceipt: opscanreceipt.cpp:25-32 uses source.snapshot/path/source kind/outcome; lambda explicitly names Canon::ParsedSource and needs StoredSource or auto after model change.
consumerAudit.CanonAdapterAndRows: canonadapter.cpp:111-118 and mediafile.h:30-34 keep shared ScanResult ownership; selected fields and evidence remain independent, no raw graph traversal.
consumerAudit.BinMetadataResolver: binmetadataresolver.cpp:63-124 tests canonScan presence and uses evidence/master IDs. AVB graph ownership is separate canonAvbSources, not ScanResult sources.
consumerAudit.AVBFiltering: avbreferences.cpp actively traverses separately loaded ParsedSource graphs; leave this reader/filter ownership unchanged in the first scan-only repair.

proposedTypes.Notes: Types are an outline, not an implementation commitment. No expanded graph cache persists inside the archived source. Materialization is one explicitly scoped RAII-owned source when needed. Partial/cancelled or failed encoding must retain existing obtained facts rather than silently omit data.

noLossRequirements: Serialize every declared ParsedSource field recursively, all original raw bytes/ranges, native Bento/MXF/AVB contexts, record sets, ordered references, typed decoded QVariant values, unknown properties, text states/basis and diagnostics.
Retain original SourceSnapshotRef identities in a small table and encode indices. Rehydrate with those exact existing pointers so evidence deduplication/coverage identity semantics remain stable.
Preserve invalid versus valid zero/false/empty, null strings/byte arrays, optional values, exact QVariant types, vector order and distinct file-specific identifiers.
Specify matching QDataStream version/byte order/floating precision. Check status on write/read and do not release original graph until the archive is complete.

Use genuine corpus graph fingerprints and typed round trips; compare projections, final evidence, sequence resolutions and source receipt identity. Byte-hash compression proof alone is not a typed-deserialization proof.
transientMemory: Monolithic QDataStream QByteArray + qCompress requires graph plus full serialized buffer plus compressed output simultaneously; avoid it for a first memory repair.

A QIODevice sink can compress modest fixed blocks with qCompress(level1), removing the source-sized temporary buffer and allowing cancellation between blocks. Sequential decompression feeds QDataStream from one bounded block.

The largest original graph still expands during initial parsing and during scoped materialization; per-value QVariant/QString/QByteArray reconstruction may create more individual allocations than the original graph unless sharing is restored.
Current projections/observations and discovery/UI rows remain hot. Compression alone does not eliminate those costs or prove 300000-file scalability.
Cancelling mid-freeze must not demand finishing compression; retain the current obtained graph/observations and stop scheduling further sources.
touchpoints: scanengine.cpp read/project/freeze boundary and summary initialization
CMake registration and meaningful genuine round-trip/scan tests
readers: PMR/MDB/MXF/legacy reader implementations can remain unchanged: each continues returning ParsedSource. AVB bin graphs need not be packed in this first repair.
compactNativeAlternative: For a longer-term representation, store exact bytes/ranges in source arenas and compact property/native-context/relationship indices; materialize decoded QVariant views as needed. This avoids one large wrapper/QSharedPointer/QVariantMap allocation per native value, but changes more reader/model/consumer access and has greater migration risk than a scan-boundary archive.
existingPools: Do not propose key/name interning as new: failing e472 already shares OMF numeric keys and dictionary QString names. Repeated MXF dictionaries cannot be merged wholesale because original UIDs/references differ.
recommendation: First measure a bounded-block in-RAM archive on the genuine MDB/header corpus, then prove typed restore and pointer/identity behavior before integrating at the scan boundary. It is a contained storage repair, preserves parsers/matching/UI/file operations, and should not be sold as a guaranteed RAM or speed target before measurement.

prototypeIndependentReview.scope: Read-only review of first prototype source; root independently confirmed compressed QByteArray spare capacity, preserved unsqueezed artifacts, and is rerunning after per-block squeeze/capacity accounting.
prototypeIndependentReview.fieldCoverage: Graph serializer covers all declared source fields, raw/decoded properties, optional encodings/basis, native contexts, snapshot values, ordered relationships/recordedReference, record sets, diagnostics, embedded sources. It does not preserve source receipt sharing topology and has no typed restore.
prototypeIndependentReview.ownership: No expanded graph back-reference remains after graph = {}. Fingerprint owns only hash state/scratch/counters. ProjectedFile holds evidence/shared values, object handles and SourceSnapshotRefs; SourceSnapshot has no graph back-pointer. ObjectProjection object/source pointers are local to projection construction.
prototypeIndependentReview.capacityIssue: First prototype measured logical compressed payload only. qCompress output QByteArray may retain compression-bound capacity per block; sum capacities and squeeze each block before storing. Otherwise archive allocations can approach serialized raw extent despite smaller logical payload.
prototypeIndependentReview.measurementCaveat: Baseline memoryGraphAndProjection is captured before hashing; packed settled memory is after hashing/compression and graph release. Both values are real process footprint, but allocator history differs. Do not label the difference precise live allocation or whole-app benefit.
prototypeIndependentReview.AVBCaveat: AVB projection is intentionally empty; successful byte hashes do not establish AVB sequence resolution after typed materialization.
proofNeededBeforeProduction: Typed graph round trip on all genuine reader corpus, including embedded graphs and both PMR sets
Existing SourceSnapshotRef identity reused during restore, ordered object/relationship identity preserved
Original and restored projection/evidence fingerprints and AVB sequence resolution hashes equal
Same live scan selected fields/read scheduling/issues/stamps and file-operation identity checks
Settled/peak RAM plus CPU measured on cumulative sources and Windows workload; no 300000-file capacity claim from small corpus
